territories.name: Jamaica
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Jamaica levies a value added tax of its own, the General Consumption Tax under the General Consumption Tax Act, administered by Tax Administration Jamaica: a standard rate of 15 per cent since 1 April 2020, a rate of 25 per cent on telephone services and instruments, zero rating for exports and the zero-rated schedule, and exemption for the supplies the Act exempts.
